messages:
aria: Kicking off staged rollout for service `serve-inference` -> revision v2026.03.21. Plan: canary 2% for 30m, then 10% for 30m, then 50% after ops signoff. Change window 03/21 22:00-23:00 PST. Release notes: https://intranet.redwood/release/serve-inference/v2026-03-21 :rocket:

deploy-bot: CI ✅. Started rollout (id=roll-8234). Canary group created at 2%. Rolling across ap-south and eu-west zones first.

kai: @aria quick check — do we have the eu kvcache warmup flag enabled in this revision? Last time cold KV was the culprit for tail latency.

aria: yes, `--kvcache-warmup=enabled` in the rollout config. still want to watch for tail.

opsbot: Telemetry: initial canary requests showing +15ms p95 tail in eu-west-1 and 0.08% 5xx (baseline 0.03%). No user-facing errors yet.

marta: :eyes: that's small but nonzero. given it's tail latency I vote hold-at-2% for an extra 15m to let K/V settle.

samir: I can trigger a targeted warmup on the canary VMs — running synthetic warmup now. Command: ```/ops warmup --service serve-inference --targets canary --duration 3m```

opsbot: Warmup job started by samir. Warmup synthetic QPS 50r/s for 3m.

deploy-bot: Note: rollback hook is preconfigured. If 5xx > 0.5% for 5m or p95 increases > 50ms vs baseline we will auto-stop and pin to previous stable (v2026.03.20).

eng-oncall: Adding a temporary alert: eu-west canary tail > 40ms triggers slack paging to oncall. Confirmed.

opsbot: Warmup complete. Telemetry update: p95 tail in eu-west down to +4ms above baseline, 5xx steady at 0.03%.

marta: Good improvement. I still prefer one extra observation interval before we progress.

aria: OK. Holding at 2% for another 10m, then we advance to 10% if no drift. Vote: GO to advance in 10m? Reply with GO/HOLD.

kai: GO

samir: GO

marta: HOLD for 5m more — want to verify the spike doesn't reappear under real traffic patterns.

aria: Tally: 2 GO, 1 HOLD. I'll respect the HOLD — extend to 15m total (10m more). If still stable we'll auto-advance.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused at canary (2%) by operator request. Next automatic check at +10m.

(10 minutes pass)

opsbot: Telemetry check: stable. p95 baseline +5ms, error rate 0.02%. No new anomalies.

aria: Given stability, advancing to 10% in 30s. Reminder: rollback threshold: 5xx > 0.5% sustained 5m or p95 jump > 50ms.

marta: :thumbsup: please ensure EU remains pinned to previous if we see regression there — don't cascade region-wide.

aria: Noted. Region-specific fallback policy active. Executing step up now.

deploy-bot: Advancing rollout to 10% (step=2 -> step=3). Rolling out additional instances in us-west and eu-central. rollout_id=roll-8234, step=3.

opsbot: Early look at 10%: slight p99 tail increase in eu-central (+40ms) but p95 stable. Error rate unchanged.

samir: I'll keep an eye; if p99 crosses 150ms we should hold.

kai: Also pinging infra to watch for K8s pod restarts during the step — last rollout caused a node churn.

infra-bot: Noted. No pod churn observed in the last 5m.

aria: Consensus? GO to continue to 50% after planned 30m soak? Say GO/HOLD.

marta: HOLD until we confirm p99 returns closer to baseline (15m soak).

samir: GO — low errors and p95 good.

kai: GO for non-eu. EU: HOLD until p99 < 30ms delta.

aria: Alright final: regional nuance. We'll continue rollout to 30% for non-EU zones; EU stays at 10% pinned. If EU p99 recovers to <30ms delta within the next 20m we'll unpin and continue. Documenting decision in release notes thread.

aria: Action items: 1) marta/ops to monitor EU p99 for 20m, 2) samir to prepare quick rollback playbook (already exists), 3) eng-oncall standby for paging.

marta: on it. I'll update the release ticket with the pin.

aria: Thanks team. I'll mark this rollout as 'partial-advance-with-eu-pin' and continue automated progression for unpinned regions. If any threshold breaches, I'll call an explicit rollback.

deploy-bot: Rollout update: non-eu advanced to 30%, eu pinned at 10%. rollout_id=roll-8234. Logs: https://deploy.redwood/roll-8234

aria: Closing thread for now. Ping here if anything regresses.

eng-oncall: Copy — monitoring dashboard link: https://dash.redwood/serve-inference/roll-8234
